item.title: [Daily FT - Business/Sectors] Govt. revenue hits 56% of 2026 target in 1H; Customs leads as vehicle duties double
item.description: Government revenue and grants rose by 27.1% year-on-year (YoY) to Rs. 2.956 trillion in the first half of 2026, achieving 55.8% of the Rs.5.3 trillion annual estimate, with motor vehicle-related collections propelling Sri Lanka Customs to become the largest contributor to tax revenue.
